notes.title: v4.0.2 update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Bug fixes and changes

 Fixed an issue in the level Basement where the clown entity wasn't able to move at all.
 Added a checkpoint when you completed a certain objective in the KaleidoMode.

Notes: If you REALLY want to break the horror aspects of this game, change the jumpscare mp4 file to something your heart desires (make sure you name the mp4 file the same way it is in the original file). Have fun :3

notes.title: v4.0.1 update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Changes

KaleidoMode
 The button will now always be visible regardless if you have the ability to play it, or not.
 Made changes on how you unlock the ability to play the KaleidoMode (Hint: You unlock it by getting the true/good ending)

Notes: If you REALLY want to break the horror aspects of this game, change the jumpscare mp4 file to something your heart desires (make sure you name the mp4 file the same way it is in the original file). Have fun :3

notes.title: The Horror Story: Rebirth Update (v4.0.0)
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/HqBbq5tbLa0

Changes

 Added a new linear DLC expansion. The KaleidoMode is a free DLC that unlocks once you completed the base game by getting the good, or bad ending.
 Moved a couple of UI elements in the main menu.
 Added Nanite, and Lumen into the game.
 Added new settings to adjust on the settings menu in case your PC, or Steam Deck has a hard time getting a stable framerate.
 Made changes to where "Bonus 2" now takes you to where tape 3 teleports you at.

notes.title: The Horror Story update released
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Added a hint in Basement for anyone to learn the basics of the game. If you need to see the controls again, you can always go to the settings menu at anytime.

notes.title: The Horror Story update released
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Side Game Mode

Featuring 5 new levels:
- Double Trouble Basement
- TheGhosTaco Bush Maze (What?)
- Chaos Maze
- Race Against The Clown
- Race Against The Clowns

Patch Notes

- Adjust the first Bonus level to let the players know that they are indeed in the level, and not soft locked (some people do forget they have a flashlight.)

notes.title: v1.4 Update
notes.content:
heyo, it's been a while since I updated this game lol. I've been busy lately with Alternate Universe and my new forbidden game called My Dad Left Me lol. ight, let's go on with the patch notes now.

Patch notes
 Fixed a crash issue where sometimes when you boot up the game, it slightly crashes your PC (this was a UE5 issue, but that got fixed).
 Added a couple of sound effects into the game's UI.
 Added a Phoenix Limit intro.
 Slightly changed up some of the cutscenes.

oki, imma head to bed now. gn

-Leo
From The Phoenix Limit Team

notes.title: v1.3 now available!
notes.content:
heyo everyone, 1.3 is now available (finally lol). now let's see what's new.

The Lore

The events of Scuffy Game's story continues as there are now tapes in all 3 levels. Find them, and see how the story expands.

Achievements

You can now earn achievements in the game now, so that's pretty pog.

Store page
Here in the upcoming hours, the store page will change into something that'll hopefully be a little better than it is right now.

Patch Notes

Fixed an issue where if you complete a level and get jumpscared, the game get's soft locked.
Added more post processing so you can kinda see in the dark.
Added a settings menu for anyone who doesn't have a good computer to run at max graphics. (I probably should have added that on day 1 lol)
Added multiple endings to the game.
Changed the jumpscare sound effect so it doesn't sound like I stole it from another game lol.

Thanks for your patience guys. I will now make a devlog video on my main channel regarding this game.

Cheers,
Leo
From The Phoenix Limit Team

notes.title: v1.3 IS IN THE WORKS!
notes.content:
Heyo everyone, sorry for the long silence about update, but I've been busy lately, and with school out for the summer, I can finally focus on this more, and add additional easter eggs to it.

What's coming in this update?
Here's a list on what's coming in this update:
 An actual settings menu
 Achievements
 A continuation story from Scuffy Game
 And more

Hopefully I can get this update out as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Leo
From The Phoenix Limit Team

notes.title: v1.1 now available!
notes.content:
Heyo everyone,

First off, a huge thanks to everyone who has picked up the game. I'll try my best on pushing more updates/patches as I can before I have to move on to Alternate Universe.

Patch Notes:
Change the main menu music to an original soundtrack.
Added a transition when you completed the objective.
Added a couple of objects for something useful in the future.
Fixed a bug where if you complete Basement or Bush Maze when you already completed the game, the levels gets locked again.

Cheers
Leo
From The Phoenix Limit Team
